source.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
source.text: In the absence of an adequacy decision pursuant to Article 45(3), or of appropriate safeguards pursuant to Article 46, including binding corporate rules, a transfer or a set of transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation shall take place only on one of the following conditions: (a) the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer; (b) the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between the data subject and the controller; (c) the transfer is necessary for important reasons of public interest; (d) the transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims; (e) the transfer is necessary in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject; (f) the transfer is made from a register which according to Union or Member State law is intended to provide information to the public.
